summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Two new test files plus a LID doc were committed; all new tests fail by design at this head because the implementation (swift-openapi-generator wiring, vendored spec, generated module) is deliberately out of scope for this phase. Contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (viamin/color_matching#110/#113) are recorded in docs/openapi-generated-client.md, including two endpoint gaps: the manifest schema does not type patches/pairs (blocking full generated-type adoption for manifests) and ranked results are typed only as schema_version + sheet_id. Swift toolchain is unavailable in this container, so tests could not be executed locally; they will run in the macOS CI (swift test job).
